author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol preps (4) 384 well plates with a source plate on the Thermocycler module. For a detailed description of protocol steps, please see below. Gantry speed slowed to retard dripping.

steps.title: Prepare four 384‑well plates
steps.instruction: Prepare four 384‑well plates on the Thermocycler module; a source plate is also placed on the module. Gantry speed is slowed to retard dripping.

steps.title: Set block and lid temperatures
steps.instruction: Set the Thermocycler block to 4 °C and the lid to 40 °C while the lid is closed.

steps.title: Load P20 8‑Channel Gen 2
steps.instruction: Use the P20 8‑Channel Gen 2 pipette as required for the upcoming liquid handling steps.

steps.title: Repeat step 2 as instructed
steps.instruction: Repeat Step 2 (set block to 4 °C, lid to 40 °C) exactly, with the unspecified exception noted in the original text.

steps.title: Repeat steps 2‑4 as instructed
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 2, 3, 4 exactly, with the unspecified exception noted in the original text.

steps.title: Repeat steps 2‑4 again
steps.instruction: Repeat Steps 2, 3, 4 exactly, with the unspecified exception noted in the original text.

steps.title: Load P20 8‑Channel Gen 2 again
steps.instruction: Use the P20 8‑Channel Gen 2 pipette again as required.

steps.title: Repeat step 9 as instructed
steps.instruction: Repeat Step 9 exactly, with the unspecified exception noted in the original text.
